command: WGPU_BACKEND=vulkan X3_REQUIRE_GPU=1 cargo test -p x3-accel-wgpu --lib every_hardware_adapter_matches_cpu_hashes -- --nocapture

result.comparison: Every adapter output was compared byte-for-byte with the repository CPU reference over empty, short, rate-boundary, and 1 KiB inputs.

limitations: This proves hardware parity for SHA-256 and Keccak-256 batches on both installed adapters.
It does not by itself prove hardware Ed25519 verification or hardware secp256k1 signature-batch parity for every primitive.
GPU output remains non-consensus evidence; the CPU reference is the acceptance authority.
